headline: 25 notable citizen-written complaints this week in Austin

items.text: On right side of the street address of the 2112 SL Davis S. residence, (but the geographical location of 1164 Coleto St.) a giant blue, plastic tarp covering Post Oak root system, left there for months & months. NEEDS TO BE REMOVED!!

New Signal for south bound I-35 drivers turning right onto MLK (west bound) are backing up all the way to the off-ramp causing a dangerous merge issue. I'm not sure why there is now a sign preventing right turns on red, but if that sign is staying then at the very least can the right turn lane switch to a flashing yellow when MLK east bound traffic gets a green light? There isn't any reason why th
items.address: 699 E Martin Luther King Jr Blvd, Austin

items.text:
Channel drainage blocked due to down tree cleanup on 10/9/26 (WO- 26-223534) Piles of mud/dirt limbs blocking channel flow. Entire channel area needs to be cleaned up and dredged back down to rock.  

Rain on afternoon of 10/14/26 was stopped in channel behind my house due to blockage.  Water finally found tiny path to creep through. 

Please contact me after review site.

Excessive music and pounding bass from Naya Restaurant on West Street vibrate through our shared residential walls every weekend, including today at 4 PM. This repeatedly disrupts my home, with no effective resolution. Please investigate noise compliance, require immediate volume reduction, and provide a permanent solution.

Unable to Contact Customer - 1st Attempt. 10.19.26 SMS - Completed inspection.  Actual address of tree in photo provided is 701 E 7th St.  Tree number 19113 is just over 4 inches and has some dead leaves on the branches.  Spoke with property management and advised of the complaint.  Tree is not of regulated size.  Left voicemail at phone number provided asking they return my call.

Radio Rosewood holding another live amplified concert  please send someone. We have spoken to the management multiple times. They are not allowed Amplified outdoor music. They do not have an outdoor permit. They repeatedly ignore our requests.

The homeless encampment under the 1st street overpass in the park is out of control. They are now parking their vehicles under it with open fires, animals, trash, and a full set up. This needs to be addressed. It’s been reported on countless occasions

White f150 abandoned at stop sign causing hazard on Bahan where the traffic going from Gilwell to Thome valley is very high.  Creating health hazard as people drive around it to see & it’s dangerous plate. It was ticked once but still hasn’t moved for over a month. There is a wire coming out of undercarriage & a tire is getting low

This Mercedes has been parked in front of these mailboxes since 8/1/2026 somebody came and checked it out and reported it was fine, which is not true because the tags are expired from 2024 I need somebody that actually looks at the tags to come and look at this vehicle that is blocking the mailboxes it will force the Mail person to keep the entire neighborhood, mail, and packages at the post offic

This vehicle is parked on a public street with its left wheels facing the curb, which is listed as an illegal parking violation under Austin’s Vehicle Abatement Unit criteria. It has not moved since we have lived here, and the vehicle also has no visible registration sticker. Please inspect the vehicle for the illegal parking violation and take appropriate enforcement action. Thank you.

tree trimmers destroyed parts of my front lawn by driving over it repeatedly throughout the week. overtrimmed a LIVE OAK tree and failed to remove elm tree blocking emergency access. instead they chose to drive through my front yard with wood chipper and other trucks. damaged clothes line, fencing and french drain in back yard.

The left turn lane facing east on Riverside and turning north onto Willow Creek was super short the other night. It was only green for a couple seconds. It caused a major backup. I know I’ve had the same issue at this light before. Please fix.

I was walking through a normal sidewalk, when a dog in a tent belonging to a homeless person bit my hand for no reason, was aggressive and tried biting me more then once until the owner stopped it, many locals say the dog is aggressive to multiple other civilians, and has scared other people.

My daughter was attacked by my dog at my house. He is up to date on shots but has shown an increasing amount of aggression. I believe the only option is to put him to sleep but understand there is a process that should be followed. Please advise.

Our neighborhood had to hire a company to get this deer off the fence.  They were not allowed to take the body.  It’s on the curb in between   3909 and 3911 Bonnell drive.  We were told the city would pick the body up on the curb by us calling 311.  I have been dealing with this all day bc game wardens didn’t ever show up to save the deer or get it down once he died.   Can yall please pick it up a

There is a dead possum on the left side of the driveway when you’re looking at the home. I don’t have the resources to dispose of it but would like it removed. There’s nothing to prevent you from accessing the animal as it’s in front and not behind any Gate. It appears someone from the city came out, looked at it, and walked away. this was service request # 26-00332283

There is a dead possum on the left side of the driveway when you’re looking at the home. I don’t have the resources to dispose of it but would like it removed. There’s nothing to prevent you from accessing the animal as it’s in front and not behind any Gate.

SECOND COMPLAINT TODAY. The pounding bass from Naya Restaurant is unbearable. Powerful, constant thumping and vibrations are penetrating my apartment walls. This is an ongoing disturbance, not normal restaurant noise.
This truck’s owners removed these “no parking cones” from the designated parking in front of my household & parked with no residential parking permit. I need this space for my family! Thanks

This is regarding the traffic signal at the intersection of the I-35 northbound service road and Onion Creek Parkway. The light stays red for nearly five minutes, while the green light lasts approximately 30 seconds. Residents on Cascade Drive are often unable to get out of our own street and onto the service road because traffic is backed up so severely. What should be a routine commute can take

I think someone truck was stolen and they emptied all their tools and scrap on the side of this complex 6201 sneed cove , 78644. There are expensive tools inside that mix which is why I don’t think the actual owner did this.

There are more than a dozen missing and damaged armadillo bumps up and down Woodland between Matagorda and I-35 frontage that need repair. Several are scattered by the side of the road and in the bike late.
Omg Bungalow!!!  Music.  Wtfffff. Make it stop!

Loud music and excessive bass coming from Crown Event Center. please send someone there.  Indoor venue. I've submitted the "non emergency" complaint Friday and Saturday nights. a Sunday at 4am isn't a "non emergency".

we still have semi trucks parking on Cromwell circle please do something about it they don't unload anything they just park here and it creates a visual obstacles for traffic pedestrians and cyclists are at risk

I had a ticket in for a dead raccoon yesterday and it was picked up, but it must have had a baby that is also found dead now. Just a little off the sidewalk into the grass behind the house near the alley area.

Loose Dog in Scofield Ridge Condominiums near building 42. Very skinny, looks to have recently had puppies potentially. kind of skittish, i was trying to get closer but she kept running away and i didn’t want to chase her towards the street

Apt. 256 -
I am reporting a suspected case of animal neglect involving a dog that appears to be kept on a balcony for approximately 24 hours a day. The dog is exposed to the outdoor environment for extended periods and is forced to urinate and defecate in the same area where it remains confined. This situation raises concerns about the animal’s health, hygiene, safety, and overall well-being.

Yelping and howling dog making noise non stop (on and off) all day, every day (when it's left alone each day). It sounds like the dog is in a confined space, like a cage, but it's hard to tell. This dog is freaking out for hours on end every day since around the 7th of this month. The dog is in apt# 3516

Campers in Armadillo Park. This man came out of the area by the fence by the Water Department facility.  No one was available at the facility to inform them. 
A neighbor walking early mornings has seen people sleeping on the bridge entrance to the park this week.

Trailer has not moved , unhidge amd loaded with items.  Has not moved since it got parked. They just back up truck to appear to be hidge. It is not fair that other neighbors have to rent storage places but they get to park in the street which appears to be using trailer for holding items or business lamdscapentrimmings.

Good afternoon,

I just want to report two cars and a truck and trailer that are parked in a no-parking zone, which is also a designated bike lane. If we could get Code Enforcement out here to have these vehicles removed from the bike lane, we would greatly appreciate it.

A van is illegally parked in a designated tour bus loading zone.  It is blocking tour buses from being able to park and load/unload customers.  This causes a backup of traffic. This vehicle needs to be towed.

Tree limbs on street at end of block. Right at the back entrance/exit of Baty Elementary. Also over hanging limbs diverting traffic still attached to tree. Low hanging branches. Hazardous, especially in the mornings and bringing children to school.

Construction outside Bowie has the stoplights not working less than an hour before school is out.  Traffic is already quite backed up. There has to be a better way to do this construction than to interrupt the exit of nearly 3000 students and staff at the end of the day.  I was here before noon today and it was also a 4-way stop because of construction, but that’s fine.  Midday signal disruption d

Signal at Shoal Creek Boulevard and Treadwell facing north still not working on October 12 at 8 pm after pushing button. The white light and yellow light in the background is the sign facing south. When crossing only traffic approaching from the south would see the signal. Traffic coming from the north would not be notified of walkers crossing the street.

Requesting Purple sage and neighboring millrace rd to rezone with bicycle lanes. Roads are large enough and we’re seeing an uptick in residential families with bikes to ride to the high school and Montessori daycare in the neighborhood. Similar to the bike lanes in pecan brook but with a path from millrace and the Davis white park
